# CmpOp

A comparison operator in a [Story](Story.md) condition. An unset variable
reads as `0`, so a plain flag test is `Ne 0` and its negation `Eq 0`.

## Values

- `eq`: Equal.
- `ne`: Not equal.
- `lt`: Less than.
- `le`: Less than or equal.
- `gt`: Greater than.
- `ge`: Greater than or equal.
